name: subframe
description: Design UI for your codebase. Developers and designers can import design systems into Subframe, explore and edit pages and components, and implement designs in your app.

interface.longDescription: Design pages, components, and snippets in Subframe, a visual design tool built on HTML and CSS. Find inspiration in real landing pages, explore variations of a screen, update your theme, and write design documents. Read designs and their React and Tailwind code for implementation, or export designs as images or PDFs. On hosts that support it, a card in the chat opens the Subframe design canvas fullscreen for visual editing.
defaultPrompt: Design a landing page for a neighborhood bakery, using real landing pages for inspiration.
Create three variations of a personal finance dashboard with distinct layouts.
Design an event page with a speaker lineup, schedule, and a bold orange theme.
